units.source_text: 红梅大纳言对于子女，不分亲疏，个个同样地疼爱。

en.t: The Grand Counselor Kobai loved all his children equally, without distinction between those close to him and those more distant.

units.source_text: 然而各人身边的侍女之中，有几个品行欠佳的人，彼此间时时发生龃龉。

en.t: However, among the ladies-in-waiting around each of them, there were a few women of poor conduct, and quarrels often arose between them.

units.source_text: 幸而真木柱夫人气度宽大，性情豪爽，善于调停排解。

en.t: Fortunately, Lady Makibashira was broad-minded and generous by nature, and was skilled at mediating and smoothing things over.

units.source_text: 即使有了不利于己之事，也能处之泰然，善自解慰。

en.t: Even when something happened to her disadvantage, she could meet it calmly and console herself well.

units.source_text: 因此没有家丑外扬，一向平安度日。

en.t: As a result, no family disgrace became known outside, and they continued to live peacefully.

units.source_text: 三位女公子年龄相仿，渐渐长大成人，都行过了着裳式。

en.t: The three young ladies were close in age, gradually grew into adulthood, and had all undergone the ceremony of putting on the mo.

units.source_text: 大纳言建造了几所七架宽阔的广大邸宅，南厅归大女公子，西厅归二女公子，东厅归萤兵部卿亲王所生的女公子居住。

en.t: The Grand Counselor built several spacious mansions seven bays wide, assigning the southern hall to his eldest daughter, the western hall to his second daughter, and the eastern hall to the daughter born to Prince Hotaru, Minister of War.

units.source_text: 在一般人想来，萤兵部卿亲王已经故世，这位女公子没有父亲，定多痛苦。

en.t: Ordinary people imagined that since Prince Hotaru, Minister of War, had already passed away, this young lady, left without a father, must surely have many sorrows.

units.source_text: 然而她的父亲和外祖父等遗留给她的财产宝物甚多，因此内部排场及日常生活高尚典雅，境况优裕。

en.t: Yet her father, her maternal grandfather, and others had left her a great many possessions and treasures, so the arrangements within her household and her daily life were refined and elegant, and her circumstances were affluent.
